response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), s AS (SELECT region, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM r) AS share FROM r), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share_above, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Share = region client count / total client count; the 'average share across regions' is the unweighted mean of the regional shares over all regions that have at least one client.
Regions are identified by district.A3 and every client has a matching district row (inner join).
